description: The body of work approach is a standard setting methodology in which \"Reviewers examine all of the data for a student and use this information to place the student in one of the overall performance levels.\" Standard setters receive papers demonstrating the complete range of possible scores from low
title: Body of work approach to standard setting for alternate assessments

description: The article introduces BtBC as a dyadic measure derived from video-based Motion Energy Analysis, \"a computer-vision method based on the assessment of differences in sequences of frames in video recordings, requiring no motion capture devices on instructors or learners\".
title: Body-to-Body Coupling (BtBC) via Motion Energy Analysis

description: BA is one of two item parameter adjustment methods proposed in the article, reducing biases in both item difficulty and item discrimination parameters using statistical bootstrapping.
title: Bootstrapping adjustment (BA) method for item parameter bias reduction
